title: Import Worksheet
subtitle: Upload any .xlsx or .csv inventory sheet — it does not have to match a template. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
saveTemplateLabel: Save this column mapping for next time as
historySubtitle: If something in inventory looks wrong later, this is the trail back to the file that caused it.
enrichmentOff: {category}: {envVar} not configured — enrichment will be skipped for these.
errCategoryColumn: Could not read the category column.
mapIntro: We read {count} columns from your file and guessed what each one means. Change anything that looks wrong — only Name / Title and Category are required.
mapTemplateApplied: Pre-filled from your saved mapping "{name}" ({percent}% of the columns match). Check it over — a saved mapping is a starting point, never applied silently.
mapMissingRequired: Still needed: {fields}. Pick the column that holds that data before continuing.
mapDoubleMapped: {details}. That is allowed, but check it is what you meant.
mapWeakGuess: Possible match: "{header}" — too unsure to pick for you.
catIntro: Your file uses {count} distinct values in the category column. Point each one at a category in this store.
catNoColumn: No category column is mapped, or it is empty on every row. Every row will fail — go back and map a category column.
catUnresolved: {values} values still unmatched, covering {rows} rows. Those rows will be marked "can't import" and left alone.
stageIntro: Every row was checked against this store's existing inventory. Nothing is saved until you confirm at the bottom.
bulkIntro: Sets every row of that type at once. You can still change individual rows afterwards.
stageUnreadColumns: Columns in your file that nothing reads: {headers}.
aboutLine: {created} new cards created, {updated} existing cards updated, {skipped} rows skipped
aboutFlagged: — of which {count} still flagged for review and will be skipped unless you decide
catCreatePrefix: Need a new category? Create it in Settings first, then re-upload:
photosFound: {found} reference photos found, {without} without a match.
photosNone: No reference photos were found for this batch.
reHeading: Re-align card numbers to this file
reIntro: This changes only each card's lookup number so it matches the number in your file. No other card detail is touched, and nothing is added or removed.
reUntouched: {count} cards in this store aren't in the file and keep their current numbers: {examples}
reDone: {count} cards renumbered to match your file.
